# My Coding Place

> > My Coding Place offers comprehensive STEM and coding education for kids and teens ages 7-18 in Austin, Texas, with classes, camps, and tech consulting services.

My Coding Place is an Austin-based educational institution founded by Amy and Fahd, specializing in hands-on coding and STEM instruction using languages like Python, C++, Java, and platforms such as Scratch, Godot, and Roblox Studio. The organization serves the local community through year-round classes, seasonal camps, school partnerships, and tech support consulting.

## Key Topics

- STEM education
- Coding classes
- Game design
- Robotics

## Core Programs

- [STEM Classes](https://www.mycodingplace.com/classes): Year-round coding and STEM classes including game dev, digital arts, robotics
- [STEM & Coding Camps](https://www.mycodingplace.com/camps): Summer and seasonal STEM camps covering coding, game dev, robotics, 3D printing
- [Middle School Coding & STEM](https://www.mycodingplace.com/middle-school): Specialized coding and STEM classes for middle school ages 11-18 with Godot
